name: RE-00 Lead Capture -> WhatsApp Buttons -> Site Visit (localhost)

parameters.content:
## 1. LEAD CAPTURE
Ads / campaign / app / website POST here:
http://localhost:5678/webhook/lead-intake

Body: name, phone, email, project, source, campaign, budget, configuration, timeline, message

Lead is written to Google Sheets (CRM) and the buyer instantly gets a WhatsApp welcome with 3 buttons.

## 2. BUTTON HANDLER
Every WhatsApp reply lands here.

VIEW DETAILS -> photos + full specs
DOWNLOAD BROCHURE -> PDF document
SCHEDULE VISIT -> free slots -> Google Calendar + sales manager + CRM

Set the Meta webhook to your tunnel URL (ngrok/cloudflared) because localhost is not reachable by Meta.

## EDIT ME FIRST
The Config node holds every setting: phone number id, sheet id, calendar id, company name, sales manager.

No secrets here - the Bearer token comes from the n8n WhatsApp credential attached to each HTTP Request node.

nodes.name: Lead Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: Website form, mobile app, Meta/Google Ads bridge, 99acres, MagicBricks - all POST the same JSON here.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Message Received
nodes.notes: Point the Meta app webhook at this URL and subscribe to the 'messages' field.

nodes.name: Simulate Button Click (Local Test)
nodes.notes:
Test the whole button flow on localhost without Meta:
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/simulate -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"phone":"919876543210","action":"VIEW_DETAILS"}'

nodes.name: Use Approved Template?
nodes.notes: A lead who filled a form has NOT messaged us, so the 24h service window is closed and Meta only allows an approved template. Set USE_APPROVED_TEMPLATE=false only for test numbers already in a 24h window.

nodes.name: WA - Welcome Template + 3 Buttons
nodes.notes: Template body must be: Hi {{1}}, welcome to {{2}}! Thanks for your interest in {{3}}. Quick reply buttons: View Details / Download Brochure / Schedule Visit.
